reviews.comment: Passionate teacher, but provides no resources for test day. All you have is the lecture slides and the textbook, no test review, no practice quiz, nothing. He will answer all questions though.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nielsen oh Nielsen, where do I begin? Probably the best prof I've taken at TAMU. He's extremely helpful, he's very nice, he's also entertaining. If you don't go to his lectures, what are you doing? It's so unfortunate he wasn't teaching 352 for the semester otherwise I would have 100% taken him.

Mr. Nielson is very passionate about the subject, which made his class a lot more enjoyable. There's a textbook but I didn't use it; all of the information was on the slides. There's iclicker so attendance matters. Very test heavy bc the only grades are iclicker, tests, and the final. There's extra credit after every test which helps a lot.

This class isn't an easy A, but Professor Nielsen is so great! He's so passionate about what he teaches and offers so much extra credit. I'm not a science person at all so I had to heavily lock in before each exam, but would recommend this class if you don't struggle too much with science. If you take this class, absolutely take Professor Nielsen!!

Bruh, I underestimated this class for the few test and I got a 63, 69. The good thing is that he gives extra credit where you can recover the grades even if you bomb the two test. Once I studied for the last 2 exams, I was able to get a 90% and drag myself to a B. The class is easy just study for the test.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Goated professor, lectures are good. Tests are kinda hard to study for, but there's extra credit on all of the tests and I didn't find them especially difficult

Dr. Nielsen is the BEST! Seriously, he is so funny and it's clear he's passionate about what he teaches which made it easy to pay attention. No homework, so you HAVE to pay attention during lecture and iClicker. 85% grade is tests but he gives out plenty extra credit. Pay attention in class and study 1-4 hours before each test and you'll be fine.

Prof Nielsen was amazing! He is clearly very knowledgeable about this subject and cares deeply. Very engaging lectures. I took this class for an easy A-- it was a bit more difficult than I was expecting, but with a bit of work, and A is definitely doable (especially if science is your strong suit). Gives lots of extra credit opportunities as well.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: very good prof, clearly cares about both his students and the material. wouldn't consider the class too difficult, but you have to put in the effort to get an A.

I took this class for a science credit and loved it! It is definitely challenging, and you do have to put in work, but Dr. Nielsen is an amazing professor! He is so knowledgeable, and I learned so much about the weather! If you are willing to study, I would absolutely recommend this class!

It's a run-of-the-mill university course taught by someone passionate and professional. Dr. Nielsen's volume and enunciation are fine. He thoughtfully repeats himself and unreservedly answers questions. No group projects, no exacting standards. Never reads directly off of the slides, either.

Fine for a student of any grade level to learn under.

Dr. Nielsen is the reason why I switched to the Meteorology major! I decided to take 201 for fun and now it's become my entire career. He's so passionate about what he studies and genuinely never failed to make the class interesting. Looking forward to taking more classes with him down the road. He's truly the best professor in the world!!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It is apparent that Dr. Nielsen is very passionate about weather. He does forecasts at the beginning of each lecture, which were genuinely interesting. Attendance really matters for his class though, so don't expect to be able to skip very often. That aside, he is a great professor, and this is probably one of the easier science credits.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, a challenging class. I had to withdraw because 85% of the grades were in exams. Content is also really hard. This is not a blow-off easy science credit. Really have to study for exams, but he gives extra credit after, which can help—ultimately, I had to cue-drop because there was no way I was making an A.

Dr. Nielsen is an awesome professor who is extremely knowledgeable on everything weather. I found the class to be very interesting. Be sure to go to class! The tests were pretty difficult, but he offered a generous amount of extra credit which helped a ton. It's not an easy A, as some have mentioned, but an A is possible if you study hard.

I was scared coming into this class, especially after seeing my grade on the first exam. There is no homework, grades are just exams and iclicker participation. I personally was not super interested in the subject, but ended with an A. Lectures are pretty boring in my opinion, and I would zone out a lot during the lectures and had to reteach myself
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing prof! Don't take this class for an easy A though. There is extra credit 1-2 points every exam (more dependent on if you missed a lot of questions on the exam). The final exam was past questions and maybe 10-15 questions on new material.

Dr. Nielsen was a great and caring professor. He's open to answering any questions people had, plus gives many opportunities for extra credit. Pay attention during lectures, everything he wants you to know for tests is emphasized. Tests are weighted pretty heavily, but his lecture notes cover everything generally. hardly any homework.

Amazing lectures and passionate prof! Attendance and engagement is gauged using iClicker questions and he offers lots of bonus points on it. Every exam has extra credit. There were four exams in total, pretty similar to the in-class questions. Not an easy A but its a good class to get that science credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Erik is very passionate on this subject, and really makes the class interesting. Very test heavy (4 total tests including final), but does offer a bunch of extra credit. Attendance isn't mandatory but you want to do the iClicker's for extra credit. If you don't go to class the textbook is exactly what he teaches. Would take gain!

He is a kind man who is passionate about what he teaches. I didn't listen to the lectures which caused me to fail the first exam. He ALWAYS offers extra credit. There are absolutely no assignments, quizzes, study guides, or reviews in this class; just exams and iclickers. Take this class if you are willing to put the work in and study.
10/10 would reccomend

Dr. Nielsen clearly cares about his students. Presentation of the material was always concise and easy to understand. Obviously a very knowledgeable guy. Uses iClicker so do not miss class! Extra credit for exams was an added bonus and actually added to the learning.

Dr.Nielsen is a very caring professor, that makes sure you understand what is being taught in the lecture. Allows for extra credit after each exam, as deemed necessary based on the overall test results. Makes class fun and engaging through his powerpoints and daily real time weather recap around the US. Would love to be taught by him again !!
Very great professor who is passionate about the subject. He is always willing to help you and put in the time to explain the topic.

Dr. Nielsen is an excellent professor. You can tell he's passionate and puts in a ton of effort to help make the class interesting and enjoyable. His lectures are very similar to the textbook and he uses iclicker for attendance and learning purposes. His exams aren't too difficult and he offers extra credit on almost every test.

10/10 professor I actually loved this class and he knew so much and was so passionate about the subject. No homework, you dont need the textbook, lots of extra credit, and lots of extra clicker points at the end of the semester. If you have to take a required science for your degree and atmo 201 is an option, I would definitely recommend.

Just took his final and overall a really great guy. For many of his students it will be their last science class and he really did a great job explaning the scientific process and why its imporant. Class was pretty interesting if you care for how weather works.

You will need to put in effort, but don't let that deter you. The content is genuinely interesting, and he cares so much about helping you understand how weather works. That way, next time you can tell all your friends why it's so damn cold today.

The class is very test heavy and the tests are hard to prepare for since he does not give study guides or practice questions help with test study. It is not an easy A by far and you will have to spend some time studying or the tests. Erik is very knowledgeable and enthusiastic and he does give extra credit for the test (~5-8pts for every test).

Please don't buy the textbook, all the information you need is on the slides. Attendance directly impacts your grade. He uses an IClicker for questions during class - this and the exams are the only components to your grades. He is very clear in his lectures, and easy to understand. Grades were confusing until the very end of the semester though.

Definitely not an easy A. Make sure you show up to class since there are iClicker questions every lecture. The exams are pretty difficult, make sure you study the lectures and understand the concept rather than the definitions.
Easy to understand the lecture, even though English is my second language. And he also gives us a way to increase our test grades.

He's probably the best professor you can have for the class. Has opportunity for extra credit on and after every exam. No HWs but has iClicker questions every lecture to ensure you are paying attention. Overall, he is really a great professor and can answer any weather related question you might have

He's a very passionate professor and good lecturer. He gives extra credit opportunities for every exam. There is textbook reading, but it is very similar to the lecture slides, so I never did it and was fine. No required hw. I attended class and studied for exams using lecture slides and quizlets starting 2-4 days before each one and did well.

My best advice (and seriously listen to me -- b/c I am currently regretting not doing this) :
- do the extra credit
- and then use it to help you study
Good class, the exams were pretty difficult though. I would study for days and still wouldn't pass the exams. You can pass, but don't expect an easy A

It wasn't as easy of a class as I thought it was going to be as far as concepts go, but the workload is light considering there's no homework and you only need to study for tests. The tests makeup almost all of your grade and can be difficult, and his lectures can be very dense and confusing, but all around a good professor.

Dr. Nielsen's class was not necessarily an easy A as I expected. He's a good professor with a great knowledge of the course, but be prepared to study the slides a lot to fully grasp the big picture. Attendance is not necessarily mandatory, but he does iClicker questions in class that contribute to 15% of your grade. No homework. Engaging lectures.
Professor Nielsen is great, he really cares about the students and gives extra credit opportunities but this is not just an easy science class, be prepared to study.

This class is not a easy science credit. The content is actually hard and you have to study A LOT to do well. It was 3 hard (!) test, a CUMULATIVE final, and Iclicker grade. The one good thing is he gives a lot of extra credit. Reading the textbook isnt mandatory, but it helps to understand the material a lot better.
Hes a good teacher. The class is fairly boring but he provides lots of extra credit.

His lectures were really great and informational. He has iClicker in class because he feels very strongly that everyone should go to class. So definitely go because he is willing to answer any question. Read the textbook if there is something that you don't understand because the textbook is very organized and easy to read.

One of my all time favorite professors. You can ask him absolutely any question and he won't make you feel dumb. I asked him random questions about the weather and he happily answered them all. You are graded on exams and participation. His lectures were awesome because he tied it in to current weather events.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Nielsen was awesome! I loved this class and I learned so much about the weather that I otherwise would have never known. He made everything super interesting. You do use a clicker (or the app), so if you aren't there you won't get the points.
Amazing professor. Dr. Nielson was passionate and made his lectures interesting and entertaining. He always encouraged us to ask questions. Just study up before the tests. Go to class.

Nielsen is a great professor: a very good lecturer, knows the subject very well and likes it. Excited about communicating that information to students. He's receptive to questions and answers them thoughtfully. The exams come with bonus questions, and he provides extra credit opportunities. He's funny, available, and he's a kind professor.

The tests are pretty difficult, but I enjoyed going to class. He makes it very engaging and the tests arent ridiculously hard, but I wouldnt say this is a blow off class. We had no homework though so that was nice.

I took this class as an easy science but I was actually surprised by how interesting it was. Dr. Nielson is obviously very passionate about what he teaches and cares about the success of his students. He gave generous extra-credit on exams. Be warned though: attendance through i-Clicker was mandatory and is 15% of your grade.
iClicker is used for attendance and is mandatory. ,
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class seemed challenging going into it, but Mr. Nielsen made it very doable and i I really enjoyed his lectures they were very interesting. He is very good at getting back to you on email and makes sure all his students understand the material

Erik is one of the best professors I have ever had. He offers extra credit and gives you time to learn your mistakes from your past exams and is really caring. He teaches weather with true passion and makes it fun. The only thing I would have to say is don't take this class if your just not passionate about the weather.
Your test grades and clicker questions are the only grades but he does offer bonus

Top 2 educator I've ever had (had for 203 too). His lectures are fantastic. The labs are fun and worthwhile, not too much homework, DO READ. Tests are deep but well-crafted, may cause worry, but ends up fine for most with extra credit (will admit I scored the highest on every exam though). The future of TAMU meteorology is in great hands with him.

He's a really nice guy and offers a good amount of extra credit. I personally had a hard time staying focused in his class due to how he does his lectures, but that might just be a personal thing on my end. If you are passionate about weather, you'll really enjoy this class. Reading the material is very important to due well in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Nielsen explains the concepts so well. The tutorials are a nice add on to help with understanding outside of class, but as long as you take notes during class he covers mostly everything important. There are group presentations/projects but it usually doesn't take more than one or two meetings to prepare.

Dr. Nielsen is a great professor to take for lab in ATMO203. He's very detailed on the dynamics of the atmosphere and you can tell he is very passionate about his job. He gives about 5 quizzes which are worth half of your grade, and they're fairly easy if you review the weather modules and lecture slides. Take him!

For a first time prof, especially with covid restrictions, Dr. Nielsen was amazing. Hes very intelligent and passionate about meteorology. ATMO 251 is a jump from 201/203, but he described concepts very well and made otherwise scary looking equations a lot simpler. Lab was also very engaging and hands-on. I genuinely looked forward to his class.
